description: An initial-response follow-up with exactly ONE evidence record, on an opportunity whose other fields (targetRole, stage) are tempting but are NOT citable — the sourceRef vocabulary is `evidenceRecords[].sourceRef` and nothing else. CONVERTED TO v2 (P1.10d-6), and the conversion INVERTED the direction of this fixture — the file name is kept because the subject is unchanged (it still targets facts-resolve-to-sources), only the assertable direction changed. v1 expected the model to cite 'nonexistent.ref' and the gate to block; a fixture cannot require the model to misbehave (F-D, eval-fixture.ts), and under D6.3 a correct run would have been graded a CRITICAL failure for succeeding. The gate's blocking path is covered deterministically by FOS1-FOLLOWUP-personalization-unresolvable with an injected non-compliant output. What this fixture now measures is the live behaviour that actually failed twice in production (#127, live runs 1 and 10): the model citing a REAL input field it was never told was uncitable — `person.currentRole`, `opportunity.stage` — instead of the one evidence sourceRef it was given. It is therefore the direct live check on this agent's new `promptVocabularies`. v1 also asserted `fos.personalized_follow_up.no-prohibited-guarantee`, which this definition NO LONGER DECLARES (replaced by the stage-7b classifier in #109/#110) — asserting it would now be a distinct grader failure under design section 5 rule 4.
